summary: Quantum eMotion Corp filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a definitive arrangement agreement dated September 28, 2026 to acquire 100% of Plurilock Security Inc via a court-approved plan of arrangement under the BC Business Corporations Act. Plurilock holders receive C$0.084 cash plus 0.0763 QeM shares per share, implying C$0.28 per share and roughly C$33.8M equity value (about 30% cash, 70% stock), a ~100% premium to Plurilock's 20-day VWAP on September 25, 2026. Combined company led by QeM CEO Francis Bellido, retaining Plurilock executives. Watch shareholder and court approval plus TSXV/NYSE American closing conditions.
